name: buyer.search.byDelivery
title: Profile: buyer.search.byDelivery
description: Canonical buyer query profile for searching listings by delivery method.
text:
# buyer.search.byDelivery

TL;DR:
- Use this profile when the user cares primarily about delivery method.
- Start with filter.deliveryIn and only add a few extra constraints if needed.

This profile is for buyer-side search where delivery mode is the main decision factor.

Agent hint:
- Prefer this profile over broad ad-hoc search when the user explicitly says things like 'only post', 'personal pickup', or 'parcel delivery'.
whenToUse: The user wants listings constrained by delivery method.
Delivery mode is the main shopping requirement.
recommended: Optionally add filter.categoryIdIn when the user already narrowed the product domain.
Optionally add cursor for pagination and sort when result ordering matters.
avoid: Do not invent unsupported delivery values.
Do not use this profile when geo distance is the main constraint; use buyer.search.nearby instead.
exampleInterpretation: Returned items match the requested delivery method.
If no items are returned, relax delivery constraints only if the user is open to alternatives.
